name: Invoize – PDF Invoices, Packing Slips, Quotations & WooCommerce Invoicing
author: WPSora

sections.description:
Invoize turns your WordPress dashboard into a complete professional invoice system — no extra software needed.
Whether you’re a freelancer sending a single invoice or an online store processing hundreds of orders daily, Invoize makes billing effortless, fast, and stunning on every device.
Create fully branded PDF invoice, packing slips, and quotations that impress clients. Convert any accepted quotation to a final invoice with just one click. Works perfectly standalone or automatically generates WooCommerce invoices the moment an order is placed.
Your clients get secure preview links, pay instantly, and download documents from “My Account” everything 100% mobile-responsive.
Developed by wpsora.com and trusted by thousands of businesses worldwide.
Documentation · Support ·

Introduction

Invoize helps you create professional invoices that match your brand and workflow created by wpsora.com. Generate PDF invoices with clean templates, track statuses, let customers preview securely, and keep numbering consistent. Receipts are created when invoices are paid, and everything works with multiple currencies so your records stay accurate.

What you can do with Invoize Free

Invoize Free lets you create and email professional PDF invoices and receipts with sequential numbering, VAT or PPN, custom items, and clean templates you can brand with your logo and colors. Customers can preview securely, pay on a single payment page, and download documents from My Account. You can add QR codes, manage clients and saved products or services, schedule polite payment reminders, and view key totals from a dashboard widget with simple revenue summaries. It works with or without WooCommerce

Create reliable invoices and receipts

Create, edit, duplicate, and regenerate invoices. Use sequential numbers with prefixes and date tags, generate professional PDFs, and share secure public previews.

Accept payments on a unified payment page

Offer bank transfer and PayPal out of the box. Use one payment page for all methods. After payment, invoice status updates automatically.

Send smart emails and reminders

Use ready templates for unpaid, paid, expired, and cancelled invoices. Attach PDFs, add your logo, and CC or BCC teammates. Schedule reminders before or after the due date.

Manage clients and your business profile

Store client details, control preview access, sync WooCommerce customers, and support guest clients. Keep multiple business profiles with logos and defaults for a professional look on every document.

Built for WooCommerce

Auto-create invoices from orders, map order statuses to invoice statuses, and sync products, taxes, discounts, and shipping. Reduce stock when an invoice is paid.

See what matters at a glance

Use the dashboard widget to view unpaid and soon-to-expire invoices and mark paid quickly. Track monthly and yearly revenue with analytics .

Customize everything important

Control Bill To, product lines, discounts, multiple taxes, notes, and key dates. Set defaults for due intervals, numbering prefixes, payment methods, email templates, and currency.

Automate routine work

Cron jobs handle reminders, log cleanup, and other recurring tasks. Statuses update from due dates and from payment gateways so your records stay correct.

Features (Free Version)

  • Gorgeous, fully branded PDF invoices & packing slips
  • Automatic WooCommerce invoice & packing slip generation
  • Sequential numbering with custom prefixes & date tags
  • Mobile-first, responsive design — looks perfect on phones & desktops
  • Secure client preview links + “My Account” download area
  • QR codes on invoices for instant mobile payments
  • Save unlimited clients & reusable products/services
  • VAT, PPN, multiple tax rates & per-item discounts
  • Custom email templates with your logo
  • Automatic & scheduled payment reminder emails
  • Dashboard widget with revenue totals and overdue alerts
  • Bank transfer + PayPal “Pay Now” buttons

Premium Features (Invoize Pro)

Everything in free + powerful automation:
* Recurring invoices (weekly, monthly, yearly) – auto-created & sent
* Quotations / Estimates – public preview + one-click convert to invoice
* Full payment gateway integration: Stripe, PayPal, Xendit (QRIS, VA, cards)
* Auto-mark invoice as Paid when payment is received
* Advanced analytics & cash-flow reports
* Late fees, overdue reminders & custom email schedules
* Multi-currency with automatic detection
* Priority support & future updates first
* Full RTL Support
* Store credit system

Features

  • Recurring Invoices: Create recurring invoices for your clients and automate your billing process.
  • Reminder Emails: Send automatic reminders to your clients for overdue invoices.
  • Multi-Currency Support: Create invoices in multiple currencies and accept payments in your preferred currency.
  • Discount and Tax: Add discounts and taxes to your invoices to reflect the accurate amount.

Integrations

  • WooCommerce Integration: Seamlessly create invoices for your WooCommerce orders automatically.
  • PayPal Integration: Enable clients to pay invoices directly through Paypal. For details, see Privacy Policy and User Agreement.
  • Xendit Integration: Accept payments conveniently via Xendit, a payment gateway popular in Indonesia that supports various payment methods. Learn more by reviewing their Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
  • Stripe Integration : Accept payment conveniently via StripeStripe, a leading global payment processor that supports credit/debit cards, digital wallets (like Apple Pay and Google Pay), ACH transfers, and various international payment methods.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Invoize”
  3. Install and activate
  4. Visit Invoize > Settings to add your logo, company details & numbering
  5. Start creating invoices or let WooCommerce do it automatically!
sections.faq:
Can I convert a quotation to an invoice with one click?

Yes! In Pro, simply click “Convert to Invoice” — all items, prices, and taxes are copied instantly.

Does it generate packing slips?

Yes — both free and Pro versions generate clean, branded packing slips automatically for WooCommerce orders.

Is it fully mobile-responsive?

Absolutely. Invoices, preview pages, and payment pages look perfect on smartphones, tablets, and desktops.

Does it auto-create WooCommerce invoices?

Yes. As soon as a WooCommerce order is placed, Invoize instantly generates the PDF invoice and/or packing slip.

Can clients pay directly from the invoice?

Free: PayPal & bank transfer links.
Pro: Stripe, PayPal, Xendit integration with automatic “Paid” status.

Is recurring invoicing available?

Yes, in Invoize Pro — set it once and let cron create and email invoices forever.

Where do I get help?

We reply fast! Contact us anytime at wpsora.com/contact

What is Store Credit?

Think of Store Credit as a private digital currency between you and your customer. Instead of sending cash back for a returned item or an overpayment, you “bank” that value into their Invoize account. The customer can then apply that balance to their next purchase with just one click.

Open Source: Invoize is open source software. You can find the complete source code on our GitHub repository, ensuring transparency and allowing you to review, contribute, or customize the plugin according to your needs.
